title: Gitee

The Gitee provider covers gitee.com through the Gitee Open API v5. It reads and writes issues and pull requests. It also covers notifications, releases, repository contents, check runs and repository webhooks. The provider doesn't cover the enterprise edition (`e.gitee.com`).

::note
The Gitee provider is experimental. No recording of the live forge verifies it, so most of its capabilities are `'experimental'`. See [Capabilities](/concepts/capabilities).
::

## Authentication

The provider accepts a personal access token or an OAuth access token. It sends the token in an `Authorization: token <token>` header, so the token doesn't appear in URLs:

```ts
import { gitee } from 'forges/gitee'

const forge = gitee({
  auth: { type: 'token', token: process.env.GITEE_TOKEN! },
}).create()
```

Without `auth`, the provider makes anonymous public reads.

## Instance

The instance is `gitee.com`. `baseUrl` defaults to `https://gitee.com`, and the provider appends `/api/v5`.

## Issue numbers and states

Issue numbers are alphanumeric, such as `I8ABCD`. Pull request numbers are integers.

A Gitee issue is `open`, `progressing`, `closed` or `rejected`. The provider maps these states as follows:

- `progressing` issues are open, so a listing of open issues includes them.
- `rejected` issues are closed, with `stateReason: 'not_planned'`.

## Assignees and reviewers

On Gitee, the reviewers of a pull request are stored as its assignees. The provider reports them in `thread.reviewers`, and `requestReview()` sets them. An issue has a single assignee, so assigning more than one user rejects.

## Merging

Gitee doesn't report which merge methods a repository allows, so `merge()` requires `method`. Without it, the call throws `MergeMethodRequiredError`. `whenChecksPass` is unavailable.

## Reviews

Gitee records an approval, but it has no endpoint to read reviews. `threads.reviews()` is unavailable, and `createReview()` accepts the `approve` event only.

## Latest release

The release that Gitee marks as latest can be a prerelease. `releases.latest()` returns the newest release that isn't a prerelease.

## Search

`search.threads()` searches issues only. A search with `kind: 'pull_request'` returns an empty page with a `kind_unsupported` warning.

## Webhooks

Set `webhookSecret` to the hook's password or signing secret:

```ts
const forge = gitee({
  webhookSecret: process.env.GITEE_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
}).create()

const events = await forge.webhooks.ingest({
  headers: request.headers,
  body: await request.text(),
})
```

Gitee sends the password or the signature in `X-Gitee-Token`, and the provider accepts either one:

- In password mode, `X-Gitee-Token` contains the password.
- In signing mode, `X-Gitee-Token` contains the URL-encoded base64 HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Gitee-Timestamp>\n<secret>`. The signature covers the timestamp but not the body. The provider rejects timestamps more than one hour from the current time.

Webhook management works on repositories only. Gitee has no delivery log, so `webhooks.deliveries()` and `webhooks.redeliver()` are unavailable.

::contributing{title="Record Gitee fixtures" to="/contributing/record-fixtures"}
```sh
GITEE_TOKEN=... FIXTURE_GITEE_REPO=owner/repo FIXTURE_GITEE_PULL=1 \
pnpm record-fixtures gitee
```

To add an issue, set `FIXTURE_GITEE_ISSUE`.
::
